papers.title: Benchmarking Topological Awareness: A Comparative Study of Physics-Informed vs. Learned Graph Architectures for System-Level Anomaly Detection in Offshore Subsea Networks
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Offshore subsea production systems represent some of the most complex and safety-critical assets in the oil and gas industry, generating continuous high-dimensional multivariate time series data from hundreds of sensors distributed across multiple production wells. Current anomaly detection approaches largely rely on point-based threshold alarms or black-box deep learning models, both of which fail to capture system-level behavioral changes where inter-sensor relationships shift even when individual measurements remain within acceptable limits. This paper presents a rigorous comparative study of two graph construction strategies within the Graph Deviation Network (GDN) framework applied to a proprietary operational dataset from 6 active offshore subsea production wells (~100 sensors): (1) a Learned Topology, in which the graph structure is inferred entirely from sensor data using GDN's embedding-based structure learning, and (2) a Physics-Informed Topology, in which the adjacency matrix is manually constructed from Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) to reflect verified physical connections between sensors and actuators. Performance is evaluated using a semi-supervised framework trained exclusively on normal operational data, with system-level anomalies labeled in the test set. The primary contribution of this work is a quantitative benchmark that isolates and measures the specific value of embedding P&ID topology into a GNN-based anomaly detection framework for offshore subsea assets, with direct implications for engineering interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
海上水下生产系统是石油和天然气行业中最为复杂且安全性要求极高的资产，它们通过分布在多个生产井中的数百个传感器生成连续的高维多变量时间序列数据。现有的异常检测方法主要依赖于基于阈值的报警机制或黑盒深度学习模型，但这些方法无法捕捉系统层面的行为变化——即使单个测量值仍在可接受范围内，传感器之间的相互关系也可能发生变化。本文在图偏差网络（Graph Deviation Network, GDN）框架内，对两种图构建策略进行了严格的比较研究，这些策略应用于来自6口活跃海上水下生产井（约100个传感器）的专有运营数据集：（1）“学习型拓扑”（Learned Topology），其中图结构完全通过GDN的基于嵌入的结构学习方法从传感器数据中推断得出；（2）“物理信息驱动型拓扑”（Physics-Informed Topology），其中邻接矩阵是根据管道和仪表图（Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams, P&IDs）手动构建的，以反映传感器与执行器之间的物理连接关系。性能评估采用仅在正常运营数据上训练的半监督框架进行，测试集中标注了系统层面的异常情况...。研究方法：深度学习、时间序列。

papers.title: Seismic-Informed Machine Learning for Performance Forecasting and Strategic Infill Drilling in a Mature Carbonate Field
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Optimizing recovery and extending the economic life of mature hydrocarbon reservoirs presents a significant challenge, necessitating advanced, integrated approaches for accurate performance prediction and strategic decision-making. This study demonstrates an application of a data-driven workflow leveraging machine learning to enhance reservoir management and characterization within a complex, highly fractured, faulted, and mature carbonate field (Field C), specifically targeting strategic infill well placement. The methodology begins with comprehensive data collection and analysis, focusing on spatial estimation of reservoir properties from well logs and on integrating seismic attributes, with interval velocities calibrated using check-shot measurements. Performance prediction models based on artificial neural networks (ANNs) were developed using a dataset from 31 wells. These models incorporated 28 input parameters, including raw well logs, estimated reservoir properties, production histories, and operational/geographical features, to predict 9 key production indicators. The ANN architectures, comprising two to three hidden layers and trained with a resilient backpropagation algorithm, achieved high R² values on both the training and testing datasets. Sensitivity analysis identified time-normalized cumulative oil/water production, water saturation, the last day of production, X-coordinates, and active production days as the most critical variables influencing well performance, a finding consistent with exploratory data analysis. Following a rigorous model selection process to optimize architectures and neuron configurations, the top-performing models (specifically the 95–75 and 90–49–31 architectures) accurately forecasted oil rates, cumulative oil volumes, and water cut over short- and medium-term horizons. Ultimately, the workflow identified potential high-production zones for a two-year horizon and recommended specific locations in the southwestern and central regions of Field C for future infill drilling.
papers.summary_zh:
【绿色金融与可持续发展】摘要  
优化成熟烃类储层的开采效率并延长其经济寿命是一项重大挑战，这需要采用先进的、综合性的方法来进行精确的性能预测和战略决策。本研究展示了一种基于数据驱动的工作流程，该流程利用机器学习技术来提升在复杂、高度断裂且富含断层的碳酸盐岩储层（C储层）中的储层管理和特征分析能力，尤其侧重于战略性注水井的选址。该方法首先进行全面的数据收集与分析，重点通过井测井数据对储层参数进行空间估算，并结合地震属性数据；其中，区间速度值通过检查井测量结果进行校准。基于人工神经网络（ANN）的性能预测模型利用来自31口井的数据集进行构建。这些模型包含了28个输入参数，包括原始井测井数据、估算的储层参数、生产历史记录以及运营/地理特征信息，用于预测9个关键的生产指标。所采用的ANN架构包含两到三个隐藏层，并通过具有良好鲁棒性的反向传播算法进行训练，在训练集和测试集上均取得了较高的R²值。敏感性分析表明，时间标准化后的累计油/水产量、含水饱和度、最后生产日、X坐标以及活跃生产天数是影响井性能的最关键变量，这一发现与探索性数据分析结果一致。经过严格的模型筛选过程（包括优化架构和神经元配置），表现最佳的模型（...。研究方法：机器学习、神经网络。

papers.title: Bounds for Standard Errors in Combined Data
papers.abstract: We propose methods for constructing lower bounds on the standard errors of parameters estimated from moment conditions obtained across different samples. Sharp explicit bounds are derived by exploiting geometric inequalities when no information about correlations across samples is available. Furthermore, we develop computationally tractable sharp bounds for more general settings with no or partial correlation information, which can be obtained by solving a simple semidefinite program. Finally, we illustrate the practical usefulness of our method through three empirical cases: two macroeconomics examples involving menu cost and Heterogeneous Agent New-Keynesian models; and a two sample instrumental variable microeconomic study.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种方法，用于根据在不同样本中获得的矩条件来估计参数的标准误差，并构建这些标准误差的下界。在缺乏样本间相关性信息的情况下，通过利用几何不等式，我们推导出了精确的显式界限。此外，我们还为更一般的情况（即完全或部分缺乏相关性信息的情况）开发了计算上可行的精确界限，这些界限可以通过求解一个简单的半定规划来获得。最后，我们通过三个实证案例展示了我们方法的实际应用价值：两个涉及菜单成本和异质代理人新凯恩斯模型的宏观经济案例；以及一个双样本工具变量微观经济研究。。研究方法：工具变量。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Peer Effects with Endogenous Network Formation
papers.abstract: This paper introduces a new econometric framework for modeling social interactions with heterogeneous peer responses, addressing endogenous link formation. Our Selection-corrected Heterogeneous Spatial Autoregressive (SCHSAR) approach jointly models link formation and outcome determination. We incorporate a finite mixture structure to capture heterogeneity in peer effects and account for unobserved individual-specific factors driving both network formation and outcome equations, addressing network endogeneity for credible estimation of heterogeneous spillover effects. We propose a fully Bayesian data augmentation approach for estimation and inference, overcoming challenges posed to standard likelihood-based methods. A simulation study validates our approach. Our empirical application to an innovation network among U.S. firms reveals significant positive, yet heterogeneous, peer effects on corporate R&D investments, after accounting for endogenous network formation. The findings highlight varying firm behaviors in response to exogenous R&D policy shocks and and quantify firm-level direct and spillover effects, offering valuable insights for evidence-based and targeted policy design.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文提出了一种新的计量经济学框架，用于模拟具有异质性同伴反应的社会互动现象，同时解决了网络形成中的内生性问题。我们提出的“选择校正异质空间自回归模型”（Selection-corrected Heterogeneous Spatial Autoregressive, SCHSAR）能够同时刻画网络形成过程与结果决定机制。该模型引入了有限混合结构（finite mixture structure），以捕捉同伴效应的异质性，并考虑了那些影响网络形成与结果方程的未观测个体特定因素，从而有效解决网络内生性问题，为异质性溢出效应的可靠估计提供了理论基础。我们还提出了一种基于贝叶斯方法的数据增强技术（fully Bayesian data augmentation approach），以克服传统基于似然估计方法的局限性。通过模拟研究验证了该模型的有效性。在对美国企业创新网络的实证分析中，我们发现：在控制了网络形成的内生性因素后，同伴效应对企业研发投资具有显著的正面影响，但这种影响存在显著差异。研究结果揭示了企业在面对外部研发政策冲击时的不同反应行为，并量化了企业层面的直接效应与溢出效应，为基...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、数值模拟。

papers.title: Digital Financial Transparency in Local Governments: The Role of Leverage, Dependency, and Fiscal Independence
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study examines the influence of leverage, regional dependency, and regional independence on the disclosure of local government financial statements through internet-based reporting. The research employs a quantitative method with a causal approach using secondary data obtained from the financial statements of local governments in Kalimantan for the fiscal years 2018–2022. The sample was selected using purposive sampling, resulting in 30 observations. Data were analyzed using multiple linear regression analysis after passing classical assumption tests, including normality, multicollinearity, and heteroscedasticity tests. The results indicate that leverage has a significant effect on the disclosure of local government financial statements through the internet. Regional dependency, however, does not significantly affect financial disclosure. Meanwhile, regional independence shows a significant positive effect on the disclosure of financial statements. These findings suggest that the financial characteristics of local governments, particularly leverage and fiscal independence, play an important role in encouraging transparency and accountability in internet-based financial reporting. The coefficient of determination shows that the independent variables explain 34.4% of the variation in financial disclosure, while the remaining variation is influenced by other factors not included in this study. This study highlights the importance of strengthening financial independence and improving financial management practices to enhance transparency in local government financial reporting.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本研究考察杠杆、区域依赖及区域独立对地方政府通过互联网披露财务报表的影响。

🔬 研究方法：研究采用因果定量方法，利用2018-2022年加里曼丹地方政府财务报表的二手数据，通过多重线性回归分析及经典假设检验得出结论。

📊 核心发现：研究发现杠杆和区域独立对财务披露有显著正向影响，而区域依赖的影响不显著；自变量解释了34.4%的变异。

💡 应用价值：研究表明，加强财政独立和改善财务管理实践对于提升地方政府互联网财务报告的透明度和问责制至关重要。

papers.title: Assessing Geological Fidelity of GAN-Generated Seismic Images for CO2 Monitoring at Sleipner
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Time-lapse seismic monitoring is a fundamental method for tracking subsurface CO2 migration in geological storage projects, yet seismic datasets are often limited by sparse temporal sampling, acquisition cost, and variability in survey geometry. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) offer a route to seismic data augmentation and interpolation, but their implementation in subsurface operations requires rigorous validation of geological fidelity at the level of individual seismic sections.
                  This paper develops an integrated generative and evaluation framework using the Sleipner CO2 storage project as a benchmark. StyleGAN2-ADA, a GAN variant, is trained on 3,149 inline sections spanning the 1994 pre-injection baseline and multiple post-injection monitor surveys acquired between 1999 and 2010. To address limitations of conventional GAN evaluation practices, which rely primarily on dataset-level metrics such as Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and Kernel Inception Distance (KID), a single-image quality assessment framework tailored to seismic data is introduced. The framework integrates the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) with component decomposition, Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS), amplitude-histogram analysis, and geological interpretability criteria including reflector continuity, thin-layer visibility, and stratigraphic coherence. This multi-level evaluation reveals trade-offs between global distributional realism and local structural fidelity that are not captured by FID alone.
                  Results demonstrate that GAN-generated seismic images replicate key CO2 plume architectures and large-scale structural patterns, but single-image evaluation reveals systematic trade-offs between distributional realism and local geological fidelity that are not captured by FID or KID alone. Grayscale and perceptually uniform representations outperform conventional colormap-based representations for generative training, and conservative amplitude-domain contrast enhancement (CLAHE) improves thin-layer visibility without distorting amplitude statistics. Latent-space projection in the extended StyleGAN2 latent space W+ confirms that the learned manifold captures the principal Sleipner plume architecture while systematically smoothing weak shallow anomalies. The combined preprocessing improvements raise the mean projection SSIM from a prior baseline of 0.45 to 0.90 without any change to the generator architecture. These findings establish that rigorous, image-level validation is essential before GAN-based seismic outputs can be trusted in subsurface monitoring workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
时间延迟地震监测是地质储存项目中追踪地下二氧化碳迁移的基本方法，然而地震数据集通常受到时间采样稀疏、采集成本以及测量几何形状变化等因素的限制。生成对抗网络（GANs）为地震数据增强和插值提供了有效途径，但其在地下应用中的实施需要对单个地震剖面的地质真实性进行严格验证。  
本文以Sleipner二氧化碳储存项目为基准，开发了一个集成的生成与评估框架。该框架采用了一种名为StyleGAN2-ADA的GAN变体，该模型基于1994年注入前的基线数据以及1999年至2010年间获取的多次注入后监测数据（共3,149个连续地震剖面）进行训练。为了解决传统GAN评估方法（主要依赖Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) 和 Kernel Inception Distance (KID) 等数据集级指标）的局限性，本文引入了一种专为地震数据设计的单图像质量评估框架。该框架结合了结构相似性指数（SSIM）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）、学习感知图像块相似性（LPIPS）、振幅直方图分析以及地质可解释性标准（如反射层连续性、薄层可见性和地层一致性）。这种多层次评估方法...。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Group-Level Treatment Effect Heterogeneity in Difference-in-Differences: A Balanced Approach
papers.abstract: Understanding how treatment effects vary across groups is central to policy evaluation. In Difference-in-Differences designs, heterogeneity is often studied using subgroup or triple-difference analyses, which can suffer from conservative inference, reliance on parametric interaction structures, and sensitivity to differences in covariate distributions across groups. We propose the Balanced Group Average Treatment Effect on the Treated (BGATT), a new estimand that isolates heterogeneity in treatment responses from differences in covariate composition and is identified under standard conditional parallel-trends assumptions. BGATT provides a transparent target for comparing group-specific treatment effects. We derive an influence-function representation and develop estimators that are $\sqrt{n}$-consistent and asymptotically normal under flexible machine-learning estimation of high-dimensional nuisance components, enabling valid inference on both group-specific effects and differences across groups. Simulation evidence shows favorable finite-sample performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】理解治疗效果在不同群体间的差异对于政策评估至关重要。在差异-差异（Difference-in-Differences）设计中，通常通过子群体分析或三重差异分析（triple-difference analysis）来研究异质性，但这些方法可能存在推断偏保守的问题，且依赖于参数化的交互作用结构，同时对群体间协变量分布的差异较为敏感。我们提出了“处理组平均处理效应的平衡估计量”（Balanced Group Average Treatment Effect on the Treated，简称BGATT），这一新估计量能够将治疗反应的异质性与协变量构成的差异区分开来，并且在标准条件下的平行趋势假设下具有合理性。BGATT为比较特定群体的治疗效果提供了一个清晰的目标。我们推导出了该估计量的影响函数表示形式，并开发了相应的估计方法；这些方法在高维干扰成分的灵活机器学习估计框架下具有$\sqrt{n}$-一致性（即样本量趋于无穷大时估计量的精度趋于稳定）和渐近正态性，从而能够对特定群体的治疗效果以及群体间的差异进行有效的推断。模拟结果表明，该估计量在有限样本条件下也表现出良好的性能。。研究方法：双重差分、数值模拟。

papers.title: Change from within? The strategies used by public officials to advance post-growth approaches
papers.abstract: Current societies face interconnected environmental and social crises. Post-growth research argues that addressing these challenges requires a reorganization of society around the priorities of environmental sustainability, social equity, and human wellbeing over economic growth. While scholars highlight the state's potential role in enabling post-growth transformations through changes from within government institutions, post-growth-minded public officials face tensions between aspiring for radical changes of established structures while working within these structures. To understand how public officials across contexts navigate this tension, we ask: How do post-growth-minded public officials promote post-growth approaches in their work? How do the strategies differ between civil servants and elected officials? What do these strategies reveal about the capacity of the state to advance post-growth transformations? To answer these questions, we interviewed 41 post-growth-minded civil servants and elected officials. Interviews covered seven European countries and local to supranational governance scales. We find that public officials aim to influence thinking and discourses as well as decision-making processes and the implementation of policies. Overall, elected officials tend to feel that they can be more outspoken in their activities whereas civil servants are more inclined to promote post-growth approaches indirectly. Both groups pursue coalitions with various actors within and beyond their institutions. Public officials strategies underscore the limited capacity of the state to advance post-growth approaches under the current growth paradigm. We suggest that cooperation with civil society actors is central to build a sense of collective agency and to foster the interactions between symbiotic and interstitial strategies for post-growth transformations.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】当前社会面临着相互关联的环境与社会危机。后增长理论认为，应对这些挑战需要重新调整社会结构，将环境可持续性、社会公平和人类福祉置于经济增长之上。尽管学者们强调国家通过政府机构内部的变革在推动后增长转型方面所起的潜在作用，但秉持后增长理念的公职人员在追求根本性结构变革的同时，也面临着在现有体制内工作的矛盾与压力。为了了解不同背景下的公职人员如何应对这种矛盾，我们提出了以下问题：秉持后增长理念的公职人员是如何在其工作中推广后增长理念的？公务员与民选官员在策略上存在哪些差异？这些策略又反映了国家在推动后增长转型方面的能力如何？为了解答这些问题，我们采访了41位具有后增长思维的公务员和民选官员，调查范围涵盖了七个欧洲国家以及从地方到超国家层面的治理层级。研究发现，公职人员致力于影响人们的思想与讨论方式、决策过程以及政策的实施。总体而言，民选官员更倾向于在自身职责范围内直言不讳地倡导后增长理念，而公务员则更倾向于采取间接方式来推广这些理念。两组官员都试图与机构内外各类利益相关者建立合作关系。他们的策略表明，在当前的增长模式下，国家在推动后增长转型方面的能力较为有限。我们认为，与民间社会力量的...。

papers.title: Energy Poverty as a Structural Trap: The Role of Housing Efficiency and Non-Convex Technology
papers.abstract: Energy poverty persists even among households that are not income-poor, suggesting a deeper mechanism than mere budget constraints. We develop a model in which indoor thermal comfort is produced through a non-convex technology that couples energy input with dwelling efficiency. A critical efficiency threshold emerges below which the minimum comfort level is physically unattainable, regardless of how much energy is purchased. Households below this threshold suffer from structural energy poverty, which income transfers alone cannot cure. The model yields three sharp policy predictions: energy price shocks are strongly regressive, efficiency investments dominate income transfers and price subsidies in reducing energy poverty, and a cost-effective anti-poverty strategy must combine targeted retrofits with temporary income support. The results are illustrated with symbolic diagrams and formal proofs.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】即使是非低收入家庭，能源贫困问题依然存在，这表明其背后的机制比单纯的预算限制更为复杂。我们构建了一个模型，在该模型中，室内热舒适度是通过一种非线性技术实现的，该技术将能源投入与住宅能效相结合。存在一个关键的能效阈值：低于这一阈值时，无论购买多少能源，最低的舒适度水平都无法实现。低于该阈值的家庭面临着结构性能源贫困，而仅靠收入转移无法解决这一问题。该模型提出了三个明确的政策建议：能源价格波动对能源贫困的影响具有很强的累退性；在减少能源贫困方面，能效投资比收入转移和价格补贴更为有效；一种具有成本效益的反贫困策略必须将针对性的房屋改造与临时收入支持相结合。研究结果通过符号图表和正式证明进行了说明。。

papers.title: Spatial accessibility to food banks hinders food parcel uptake in England and Wales, particularly in rural areas
papers.abstract: Food bank use in the UK has soared in recent years. The combination of a global pandemic, over-stretched and underfunded public services, and a cost-of-living crisis has meant that millions of people cannot afford basic essentials such as food, heating, housing, and baby supplies. Food bank use is driven by a complex range of factors, including poverty, health emergencies, income shocks, delays to universal credit payments, housing issues, and homelessness. In this study we identify an urban-rural divide in spatial accessibility to food banks. In cities, food banks tend to be highly accessible by public transport to deprived populations but, on average, have shorter opening hours. In rural areas, however, despite generally longer opening hours, food banks are typically not highly accessible except for the most deprived residents. This matters. We find that spatial accessibility to a Trussell food bank centre is a key predictor of food parcel uptake, with a significantly stronger relationship than factors emphasised in the literature such as disability and Universal Credit. Importantly, this relationship is markedly stronger for rural populations, suggesting an unmet need in deprived rural areas far from food banks. Our work has important implications for food bank policy, suggesting a need for improved public transport in rural areas, and optimising current food bank locations and delivery models.
papers.summary_zh: 📌 研究问题：探讨食品银行的空间可达性如何影响食品包裹的领取情况，并重点分析城市与农村地区在这一问题上的差异。

papers.title: Randomized Neural Networks for estimation of exposure profiles and Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) for American Equity Options
papers.abstract: This thesis studies the use of randomized neural networks for the estimation of exposure profiles and unilateral CVA of American options within a Monte Carlo framework. The analysis is carried out separately under both Black-Scholes and Heston dynamics, combining American option valuation, expected exposure and potential future exposure estimation, and unilateral CVA calculation with portfolio netting effects.   The numerical experiment compares this approach with the classical Least-Squares Monte Carlo (LSM) used as a benchmark in both low-dimensional single-asset and high-dimensional multi-asset scenarios, and also includes a path convergence test and a sensitivity analysis. The results show that the randomized feedforward neural network approach preserves convergence to the LSM benchmark when it is extended from pricing to exposure and CVA estimation, while its main advantage appears in high-dimensional problems, where it scales more efficiently and leads to lower computational cost.   These results support the use of randomized neural networks as a useful alternative for exposure and CVA estimation in high-dimensional American-style options.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本论文研究了在蒙特卡洛框架下，利用随机神经网络对美式期权的暴露值分布及单边信用风险（CVA）进行估算的方法。分析分别在Black-Scholes模型和Heston模型下进行，将美式期权的估值、预期暴露值及潜在未来暴露值的估算与单边CVA的计算相结合，并考虑了投资组合的净化效应。数值实验将这种随机神经网络方法与传统的最小二乘蒙特卡洛（LSM）方法进行了对比，评估了其在低维单资产和高维多资产场景下的表现。实验还包括路径收敛性测试和敏感性分析。结果表明，当随机神经网络方法的应用范围从期权定价扩展到暴露值及CVA估算时，其收敛性仍能保持与LSM方法相当；其主要优势在于高维问题中，该方法具有更高效的计算效率，从而降低了计算成本。这些研究结果支持将随机神经网络作为高维美式期权暴露值及CVA估算的有效工具。。研究方法：实验方法、随机实验、蒙特卡洛模拟、神经网络。

papers.title: Semi-nonparametric estimation of spatial dynamic panel data models with nonparametric spatial weights
papers.abstract: We develop a semi-nonparametric framework for spatial dynamic panel data (SDPD) models with two-way fixed effects when the spatial interaction structure is unknown beyond a distance measure. This is accomplished by modelling spatial weights in the outcome, lagged-outcome, and disturbance channels as unknown functions of underlying economic distances. These enter the SDPD system through matrix-function operators, providing a unified approach that accommodates both spatial autoregressive and matrix exponential spatial specifications. Allowing for unknown heteroskedasticity, we propose sieve GMM estimators based on a stacked set of linear and quadratic moment conditions, and derive a feasible optimal GMM estimator and a more efficient feasible best GMM estimator. As $(n, T) \rightarrow \infty$, the parametric component is $\sqrt{n(T - 1)}$-consistent and asymptotically normal, echoing classical semi-nonparametric results. Monte Carlo experiments indicate excellent finite-sample performance. We apply the method to 'witch' killings as studied by Miguel (2005), and find that economic-geography proximity rather than cultural-geography proximity between communities significantly amplifies spatial dependence in these economic murders.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们构建了一个半非参数框架，用于处理具有双向固定效应的空间动态面板数据（SDPD）模型。当空间交互结构仅通过距离度量来表征时，该框架能够有效地进行建模。具体而言，我们将结果变量、滞后结果变量以及扰动变量中的空间权重视为潜在经济距离的未知函数，并通过矩阵函数运算符将这些权重纳入SDPD模型中，从而实现了一种既能处理空间自回归模型又能处理矩阵指数空间模型的统一方法。为了解决异方差性问题，我们基于一系列线性和二次矩条件提出了筛选广义矩估计（sieve GMM）方法，并推导出了可行的最优GMM估计量以及更高效的次优GMM估计量。当样本量$(n, T)$趋于无穷大时，模型的参数部分具有$\sqrt{n(T - 1)}$的一致性，并且渐近地服从正态分布，这一结果与传统的半非参数方法一致。蒙特卡洛实验表明，该模型在有限样本下的表现非常优异。我们将该方法应用于Miguel（2005年）研究的“女巫谋杀”案例，发现社区之间的经济地理邻近性比文化地理邻近性更能显著增强这些经济犯罪事件中的空间依赖性。。研究方法：面板数据、实验方法、广义矩估计、蒙特卡洛模拟、固定效应。
